convert_cityscapes_to_coco_instance: run the script with --dataset cityscapes_instance_only to convert Cityscapes annotations to COCO instance segmentation JSON format
convert_cocostuff_to_coco: run the script with --dataset cocostuff to convert COCO Stuff MAT annotation files to COCO JSON format
convert_cityscapes_parse_args: review the parse_args function to understand the CLI arguments for dataset, output directory, and data directory
convert_cityscapes_getLabelID: summarize the getLabelID function that extracts the label ID from a Cityscapes instance ID by dividing by 1000
convert_cityscapes_bbox_area: review the convert_cityscapes_instance_only function to see how bounding boxes and areas are computed from polygon contours
